target.name: Locus Robotics
target.founder: Bruce Welty, Rick Faulk, Al Dekin

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series F → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.3x) to $2.0B last post money.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 9 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.0B - $2.3B.

data.narrative:
Locus Robotics is a Series F robotics and manufacturing company with a current post-money valuation of $2.0B, having raised $438M to date. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer set of nine same-sector companies at similar valuation tiers, comprising eight private firms and one public company (277810.KQ), including named comps Divergent ($2.3B, Series E), Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), and Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis, using a typical Series F-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.3x applied to the $2.0B last post-money valuation, yields $2.6B. Peer-Median analysis across the nine-company robotics comparables set produced a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.3B. The peer median reflects substantial stage and valuation variance within the robotics sector, with Series B companies valued between $1.6B and $2.0B, and Series D/E positions clustered higher.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $3.0B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The target's current $2.0B valuation aligns closely with the peer median but sits below stage-progression implied value. Key uncertainties include stage-specific milestone achievement and the representativeness of early-stage robotics comparables in informing Series F value.
